versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: '/r'
    ParentCommandLine|endswith:
        - '.bin'
        - '.ico'
        - '.lnk'
        - '.lo'
        - '.sv'
        - '.usb'
selection_child_img:
    Image|endswith: '\msiexec.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|windash: '/q'
selection_child_http:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'http:'
        - 'https:'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\cmd.exe" ParentCommandLine="*/r*" ParentCommandLine IN ("*.bin", "*.ico", "*.lnk", "*.lo", "*.sv", "*.usb") Image="*\\msiexec.exe" CommandLine="*-q*" OR CommandLine="*/q*" OR CommandLine="*–q*" OR CommandLine="*—q*" OR CommandLine="*―q*" CommandLine IN ("*http:*", "*https:*")
